details:
Re-posting because I only find 2 year old posts. 
First, why do I think its worthy of considering: With the increased popularity of VRChat we have new visitors that do not have the best intentions, users that harass the general population in public worlds. There is the block/mute button for these types of people, however after blocking 15+ people in one instance (about ~1hour of playtime) sometimes you just don't want to deal with these types of people, and unfortunately, in my experience it has been 90% of the time Visitors that I have to block. This is why I think having ranked public worlds to meet new people that have gone through enough playtime to learn the etiquette of socializing in vr is a good idea.
Here is how I feel its best to implement this feature: 
-Default public instances set to all user ranks
-Option tab to filter ranks
-Can only create/filter ranked worlds lower than your own rank
-users from other ranks can join ranked public instances through friends.
Why do I think this won't "Divide" the community? because public instances are still joinable by all. Will there be less people interacting with visitors? No, the same people will still be joining public lobbies along with others, however, now people who have gone through 100's of hours of vrchat and want to be in a public lobby can now socialize in public instances instead of being in friends+ worlds or above. 
What would the point of having friends+ worlds be? Same point as now, the only change this will create will be meeting more people in public instances instead of having to block 10+ people in an instance just to meet 1-2 people that you enjoyed having a conversation with. 
English isn't my first language I'm sorry if there is some misspelling or miscommunication.
title: Trust Rank based Public worlds
